cards.title: What resolves
items: Any observation of any stored run: direct, sweep or chat tool evidence
Old name-based item IDs resolve unchanged: they are the observation's item_id
Survives API restarts and a Postgres dump/restore

cards.title: What it returns
items: The item as that run saw it, the run's state and time
resource_id and whether that resource has since been removed

cards.title: Not used by the UI yet
items: Answers render citations from the chat response's own evidence; this route serves checks and later views
